scene_summary: Two unequal, disconnected cartoon-anatomy groups sit on a cream ground with a broad open gap. At left, a green saddle-crowned creature grips a pale face connected to a long cyan-edged limb; a pink stepped face, a floating turquoise-lit black bowl, and a foliage tuft flank it. At right, a bent bone-tipped limb, pink coils, and purple lobes sit against solid red scallops, with a pale blue-streaked pointed fan behind them. Five planned source anchors are visibly distinguishable. A separate translucent jagged colored-wash ruff is not clearly visible: the red backing is solid, while the pale streaked fan corresponds to the pointed-fold anchor. The detached bent limb supplies a sixth distinct interaction target without assigning either backing to the missing ruff.
usable_surfaces: Green crown and gripping contour connected to pale head and long limb
Pink stepped face exposed behind the green silhouette
Grainy black bowl with turquoise interior
Blue-green foliage blades around a pink-yellow cleft
Pale pointed fan with blue streaks and orange-purple rim
Detached bent pale limb with cyan underside and exposed bone tip

detected_objects.label: Saddle-crowned green creature gripping a pale head and long cyan-edged limb
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Two pointed green crown ends enclose a deep saddle-shaped dip. Yellow eyes have black lower segments. Green fingers obscure a pale face with a small pink mouth, while a long cream limb extends diagonally down-right to a rounded mitten-like end. Cyan and black contours run along its underside. This is one connected dominant gesture; its complex silhouette includes deep concavities.

detected_objects.label: Pink-faced stepped protrusion behind the green creature
detected_objects.visual_evidence: An exposed pink shape has a stair-stepped upper-left boundary, short black facial strokes, and a heavy black lower edge. Its right side disappears behind the green creature. It is visibly distinct from the creature's smooth contour.

detected_objects.label: Grainy black bowl holding turquoise light
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A turquoise elliptical opening tops a black bowl covered in cream grain-like flecks. A small flared foot completes its silhouette. A violet-blue powdery halo surrounds it, but the interaction contour follows the solid bowl rather than the diffuse bloom. The bowl floats above-left of the larger group rather than sitting at its base.

detected_objects.label: Blue-green foliage tuft surrounding a pink-yellow cleft
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Tall teal and blue leaf-like blades part around a narrow yellow channel edged in pink. Black linear veins follow the blades. A cream scalloped skirt surrounds the lower edge; the polygon concentrates on the colored tuft and its warm internal cleft rather than empty cream around it.

detected_objects.label: Pale pointed fan with blue streaks and orange-purple edge
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A pale fan-like form rises to a sharp tip near the upper-right corner. Blue streaks radiate through its folds. An orange band and purple scalloped outer edge follow its right side and meet the image boundary. Its lower-left edge is occluded by the solid red backing. This is the visible pointed-fold candidate, not evidence of a second separate translucent ruff.

detected_objects.label: Detached bent cream limb with exposed bone and cyan underside
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The smaller group contains a separate cream limb bent sharply at its lower-left elbow. A red cut opening and small pale bone tip cap the upper end. Cyan follows the inner diagonal and rounded lower-right end, with black shadow underneath. This is a distinct repeated anatomical mark from the dominant creature source, not the planned translucent ruff.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The cream ground and large central gap keep two principal groups legible, and the smaller source pockets remain identifiable. Internal detail is substantial: heavy contours, facial features, coils, lobes, scallops, foliage veins, and radiating streaks make the plate more cartoon-illustrative than minimal expressionist. The right-hand fan is cropped at the image edge. Coverage is an approximate visual estimate.
